dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I'm a playwright and manager. I run the Zubayr Theater in this tree hollow.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: In addition, I also do some composing, choreography, stage design, and action direction.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: It's a small troupe. Pretty much everyone other than Kourosh wears several hats.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: So if it isn't about anything important, I'll have to ask that you not bother the staff here, including myself.
